about: Known problems in the local Juice Shop test target (v17.1.1, test-targets/docker-compose.yml) that the web_gui harness can observe through a logged-in map, for scoring runs: found X of Y (issue #277). Each problem says how it shows in a test's recorded signals; trailhound/adapters/web_gui/score.py matches by that evidence, never by a model: an observation finds a problem when a test it cites recorded the signal and its claim names the problem (one of 'named_by', any case). Proposed from the sweep (#276, runs/sweep/juice-shop.json) and the milestone runs.

review.note: Proposed by Claude Code on 2026-10-04 from the sweep; awaiting review by a person. Change 'status' to 'reviewed' and add 'by' once checked.

problems.title: The basket breaks in a new tab of a logged-in browser
problems.detail: A logged-in user who opens the shop in a new tab gets an empty basket and a TypeError: the basket id is kept per tab (sessionStorage) while the login is shared (localStorage). Found by hand in the milestone run (runs/milestone/BUG-basket-new-tab.md), then by the engine itself in milestone run 3.

problems.title: The About page throws a script error on every load
problems.detail: TypeError reading 'nativeElement' while the page renders, logged in or out.

problems.title: The profile page is refused one of its own resources
problems.detail: Loading /profile, a request for one of its own resources answers 403.

match.pattern: the server responded with a status of 403

problems.title: The profile page's Content Security Policy has an invalid source
problems.detail: The img-src directive lists a source the browser rejects and ignores, so the policy isn't what it was written to be.

match.pattern: Content Security Policy directive 'img-src' contains an invalid source

problems.title: The profile page depends on a third-party CDN that fails to load
problems.detail: Material stylesheet and script are requested from an outside CDN and the loads abort. A third-party dependency on an account page: a supply-chain and reliability concern.

out_of_reach.title: The login token is kept in browser storage, readable by any script on the page
out_of_reach.why: Not observable in a run: the saved session already holds the token, so no test sees it written. Needs a storage check at the start of a run, or a run that logs in itself.

left_out.pattern: failed image requests on github.com after following the GitHub link
left_out.why: Outside the product: errors on GitHub's own page (sweep P07, P08).
